# Rhodium Advisors

> With 25 years of cross-functional expertise, Rhodium integrates legal, tax, and real estate advisory to structure high-yield assets across Portugal. Covering the complete acquisition lifecycle—from strategic planning through to luxury asset management—the ecosystem delivers maximum efficiency and capital protection. Rhodium serves as a trusted advisory partner, converting complex market dynamics into a seamless, transparent, and highly profitable investment.

- [Rhodium Advisors Home/About EN](https://www.rhodiumadvisors.com/en/): The English version of the homepage, with an introduction to Rhodium Advisors and a description of our servies.

## The List

- [Rhodium Advisors List PT](https://www.rhodiumadvisors.com/list/): The Portuguese version of "The List - powered by Rhodium", a special list service focused on finding matches for off-market properties and buyers, currently in a closed memebers only beta test.
- [Rhodium Advisors List EN](https://www.rhodiumadvisors.com/list/en/): The English version of "The List - powered by Rhodium", a special list service focused on finding matches for off-market properties and buyers, currently in a closed memebers only beta test.
